name: Jesus Death
overview: The death of Jesus is portrayed in Scripture as the fulfillment of prophetic suffering, where He was wounded and bruised for our transgressions to bring us healing and peace, as Isaiah 53 reveals. Psalms 22 describes His anguish vividly, emphasizing the depth of His sacrifice. In the New Testament, John 3:16 affirms God's love in giving His only Son so that believers receive eternal life, while John 5:24 and John 8:12 highlight the transformative power of faith in Christ, who brings light and passes believers from death to life.
